data.text:
Comment from a patriotic PhilAm:  

"This X post is straight fire and hits right at the heart of what Balikatan 2026 is all about. Posted smack in the middle of the exercises (April 20 to May 8), it quotes Richard Heydarian reminding us that our ancestral ties to the West Philippine Sea aren’t just some map lines—they’re core to who we are as Filipinos. The caption “Defending what is ours.” plus that two-minute montage of tanks, jets, helos, and armored vehicles screaming readiness? That’s us showing the world we’re not backing down to China’s military aggression.

Balikatan 2026 is the biggest one yet—over 17,000 troops from the Philippines, US, Australia, Japan, Canada, France, and New Zealand training shoulder-to-shoulder on exactly this: maritime defense, counter-landing ops, live-fire drills, and securing our waters in the West Philippine Sea. Drills in Palawan and off Zambales are literally practicing how to push back against gray-zone harassment at Scarborough Shoal and beyond. This isn’t abstract alliance talk; it’s real, boots-on-the-ground preparation to protect what’s ours.

And that’s why the anti-US activists out there right now—protesting Balikatan, spreading nonsense about “US imperialism,” or worse, posting that fake Time Magazine cover calling Trump “Asshole of the Year”—are straight-up aligned with the CCP’s playbook. They’re not “patriotic dissent.” They’re useful idiots doing Beijing’s dirty work by trying to weaken the very alliance that’s giving us the muscle to defend our EEZ. While real Filipinos are out there training to stand firm against Chinese incursions, these clowns are undermining the partnership that keeps our sailors safe and our territory intact. It’s embarrassing. They should be ashamed of themselves for selling out our sovereignty to score cheap political points for the very power that’s bullying us in the South China Sea.

This post gets it. Balikatan gets it. The patriots get it. The rest? They’re just noise helping the other side and carrying water for the communist-influenced and corrupt politicians. Defending what is ours means standing with our allies, not tearing them down. Period."
